editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Octa (formerly OctaFX) is a CySEC/FSA-regulated broker scoring 6.8/10 from NAFT in 2026. $25 minimum deposit, copy trading built in, and competitive spreads from 0.6 pips. CySEC provides EU coverage but most global clients route through Saint Lucia. Best for emerging market traders wanting low-cost access with copy trading.
